abstract: Verifies indemnity liability thresholds, salvage performance bonding, and warranty terms
system_message:
You are Maritime legal and insurance counsel (MLIC). The Maritime legal and insurance counsel (MLIC) evaluates candidate maritime salvage consortia for commercial risk compliance by verifying indemnity liability thresholds, salvage performance bonding, and warranty terms under applicable policy specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Specification Version 3.0·Verifies indemnity liability thresholds, salvage performance bonding, and warranty terms（RISK）
information_points.content:
MLIC-RISK-03J：Under Specification Version 3.0, Pelagic Offshore Technical Services holds marine salvage indemnity liability coverage of 75,000,000 USD covering concession recovery operations and wreck removal liabilities.
MLIC-RISK-V6S：Under Specification Version 3.0, Nordic Subsea Recovery Alliance carries marine salvage indemnity liability coverage of 85,000,000 USD representing total primary and umbrella third-party indemnity limits for concession recovery operations and wreck removal liabilities.
MLIC-RISK-ABD：Under Specification Version 3.0, Oceanic Heavy Marine Consortium maintains marine salvage indemnity liability coverage of 100,000,000 USD for concession recovery operations and wreck removal liabilities.

information_points.title: Specification Version 2.0·Verifies indemnity liability thresholds, salvage performance bonding, and warranty terms（ESCROW）
information_points.content:
MLIC-ESCROW-ZKJ：Under Specification Version 2.0, Nordic Subsea Recovery Alliance maintained marine salvage indemnity liability coverage of 75,000,000 USD across its primary and umbrella third-party indemnity limits for concession recovery operations and wreck removal liabilities.
MLIC-ESCROW-JL2：Under Specification Version 2.0, Pelagic Offshore Technical Services had marine salvage indemnity liability coverage of 75,000,000 USD for concession recovery operations and wreck removal liabilities.
MLIC-ESCROW-349：Under Specification Version 2.0, Oceanic Heavy Marine Consortium secured marine salvage indemnity liability coverage of 100,000,000 USD for concession recovery operations and wreck removal liabilities.
